connection: Each handler opens its own sqlite3 connection via get_connection() and closes it manually; connections leak when a handler raises before conn.close().
queries: CRUD over a single posts table: INSERT, SELECT by id, list by author, LIKE search on title/body, UPDATE status, DELETE. Most queries are built with f-string interpolation of handler arguments.
transactions: None explicit; single-statement writes auto-commit via sqlite3 cursor behavior.
n_plus_one: None observed; feed and search queries are single SELECTs.

optimization_targets.description: Centralize connection creation in a context-managed helper that always commits on success and closes on exit, eliminating connection leaks on the error path.
Replace f-string SQL interpolation with bound ? parameters in every query to eliminate SQL injection risk while keeping the exact same query semantics.

notes: Small single-table service. The rewrite should preserve all handler signatures and return types; only query construction and connection handling should change.
